name: araoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdfs, markdowns, diagrams)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @araoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @araoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @araoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @araoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @araoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @araoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @araoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @araoffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @araoffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @araoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @araoffice/docs && npm run test -w @araoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @araoffice/shell && npm run test -w @araoffice/slides && npm run test -w @araoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @araoffice/markdown && npm run test -w @araoffice/diagram
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @araoffice/diagram
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,diagram,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,gray,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @araoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @araoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @araoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @araoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @araoffice/markdown" "npm run dev:renderer -w @araoffice/diagram" "npm run dev -w @araoffice/shell"
scripts.dev:docs-shell: concurrently -k -n docs,shell -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @araoffice/docs" "npm run dev -w @araoffice/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @araoffice/docs && npm run build -w @araoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @araoffice/slides && npm run build -w @araoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @araoffice/markdown && npm run build -w @araoffice/diagram && npm run build -w @araoffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:mac -w @araoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @araoffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @araoffice/shell
